about.title: Heritage in Every Single Detail
about.p1: From the vibrant heart of Cairo, Verella brings the timeless coffee tradition to life with passion, craftsmanship, and authenticity. Our story began with a simple vision: to honor the complex rituals of Egyptian brewing while embracing the refinements of modern roasting.
about.p2: We source only the finest beans from ethical farmers across the coffee belt, ensuring every bag tells a story of origin, resilience, and unparalleled flavor.

immersive.title: The Coffee Experience
immersive.subtitle: More than just a drink, it's a sensory journey. We source the finest beans, roast with care, and craft each cup to deliver a rich and unforgettable experience.
immersive.stat1Sub: Directly from the farm to our roastery.
immersive.stat2Sub: Small batches for maximum flavor profile.

heritage.storyP1: Since 1920, Verella has been a beacon of Egyptian coffee culture. Our journey began in the bustling heart of Mansoura, bringing together the finest ethically sourced beans with time-honored roasting techniques, crafting a legacy of rich, aromatic blends.

aboutPage.title: Our Story
aboutPage.subtitle: From a single coffee cart in downtown Cairo to a beloved heritage brand.
aboutPage.storyP1: Verella Coffee was born from a grandfather's passion. In 1952, Verella began roasting beans in a small cart near Al-Hussein Mosque in Islamic Cairo, serving the neighborhood's merchants, artists, and intellectuals.
aboutPage.storyP2: His secret was simple: source only the best, roast with patience, and serve with pride. Three generations later, we carry that same philosophy into every bag we produce and every branch we open.
aboutPage.storyP3: We source our beans directly from farmers in Ethiopia, Brazil, Colombia, and Yemen — building relationships that last decades. Each harvest is cupped, graded, and roasted in our Cairo facility before reaching your cup.
aboutPage.value1Desc: We partner directly with farmers who share our values of sustainability and fair trade.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Small-batch roasting in Cairo preserves the nuance of every origin we source.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Every product design and brewing method honors centuries of Egyptian coffee culture.
aboutPage.value4Desc: Our branches are gathering places — spaces for conversation, culture, and connection.
aboutPage.followBody: Behind-the-scenes roasting, new blends, and life at our branch — follow along on social media.
